post.description: Approve policy or deny. Origin must equal issuer. Deny requires only decision and formProof. Proof is account/request-bound. Approval validates current publication ownership. No raw tokens returned. Approval AND denial also require the provider transaction binding cookie from GET /oauth/authorize. Use the same browser/Postman cookie jar; Clerk JWT, proof and Origin alone are insufficient.

parameters.name: X-User-Id
parameters.description: Authenticated owning account ID from trusted service.

parameters.name: X-MCP-Origin
parameters.description: Required for MCP-origin work: URI-encoded JSON containing userId, credentialKind=mcp, connectionId, clientId, grantId, policyVersion and scopes. No bearer tokens; omission is only for independently trusted scheduled work.

clerk.description: Clerk JWT, management only; mutation Origin must equal issuer.

internal.description: Also requires X-User-Id; trusted service-binding callers only.
